sloka: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः ।नहि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः ।। ५.३९.३९।।।।
transliteration: ahaṁ tāvadiha prāptaḥ kiṁ punaste mahābalāḥ ।nahi prakṛṣṭāḥ preṣyante preṣyante hītare janāḥ ।। 5.39.39।।।।

translations.english: "If I have managed to come here, why not the other powerful ones? The superior leaders are not sent (as messengers). Only ordinary ones like me are.
